method: Complete XAML and code-behind reading through EOF; pinned Git blob identity verified. No WPF execution.
findings: Search is ordinal case-insensitive substring matching over Name and raw Location, with name matches first and stable original order otherwise; no content hashing, fuzzy metric or filesystem identity comparison.
Window records are collected once at construction and refreshed after history clearing only. Popup has no subscription to window changes; selected handles and record data can become stale while open.
Every nonblank query synchronously filters, repeats name matching during sorting, and materializes a new list on UI thread; no debounce, cancellation or admitted history-size cap here.
Selection starts asynchronous SwitchTo without awaiting or observing task failure, then closes popup immediately; no navigation result shown. Ctrl requests duplicate, Shift requests new window.
Clear history reload sets full unfiltered ItemsSource without reapplying current SearchBox.Text. A retained nonempty query may display unrelated results until text changes.
Dialog-state flag is reset after modal call without finally; exception can leave deactivation-close suppressed. Closing itself is guarded against repeated calls.
XAML fixed 600x450 topmost transparent popup presents both open and history records with same icon and no explicit open/closed indicator. Rendering, accessibility and scaling were not exercised.
